passages.context: The complete numbered section was inspected with sections 17 and 19. Cyprian identifies Christ as the bread of life, describes daily Eucharistic reception as food of salvation, quotes John 6's flesh-and-bread sayings, and connects exclusion from communion with separation from Christ's body. This verifies the English witness, not the Latin.
